SS0001.fix: wait for the running Consume to return, or Register another instance

SS0004.problem: stream partition size does not match the existing stream
SS0004.fix: register with PartitionSize {existing_partition_size}, or use a new stream name

queries.label: the stream row under this name
queries.sql: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM {schema}.stream_config WHERE name = '{stream}';

queries.label: the stream row behind an id, if that is what the line carried
queries.sql: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM {schema}.stream_config WHERE id = {stream_id};

queries.label: every registered stream, if the name itself is wrong

SS0006.fix: pass DestroyOptions.Force to destroy them with the stream

queries.label: how many messages the destroy would discard
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS message_count FROM {schema}.message_log_{stream_id};

queries.label: the newest of them, to judge whether the stream is still in use

SELECT

	routing_key,

SS0010.problem: a worker instance is still live
SS0010.fix: stop running managers and consumers, or pass DestroyOptions.Force

SS0011.fix: destroy them first, or pass DestroyOptions.Force to destroy them and their messages

SS0012.problem: worker instance row expired or was removed
SS0012.fix: stop the work; a replacement may already be running

SS0013.fix: register the named schedule with Client.Scheduler(name).Register first

SS0014.fix: register a consumer with this group name to create it

queries.label: every group registered on this stream
queries.sql:
SELECT
	consumer_group_config.id,
	consumer_group_config.name,
	consumer_group_config.created_at
FROM {schema}.consumer_group_config
JOIN {schema}.stream_config ON stream_config.id = consumer_group_config.stream_id
WHERE stream_config.name = '{stream}'
ORDER BY consumer_group_config.name;

queries.label: the group row behind an id, if that is what the line carried
queries.sql:
SELECT
	id,
	stream_id,
	name,
	created_at
FROM {schema}.consumer_group_config
WHERE id = {group_id};

SS0015.problem: consumer group still has a live consumer
SS0015.fix: stop the group's consumers, or pass DestroyOptions.Force

queries.label: the instances still heartbeating on this group
queries.sql:
SELECT
	worker_config.name AS worker,
	worker_instance.id,
	worker_instance.expires_at,
	worker_instance.attempts
FROM {schema}.worker_instance
JOIN {schema}.worker_config ON worker_config.id = worker_instance.worker_id
WHERE worker_config.consumer_group_id = {group_id}
	AND worker_instance.expires_at > now()
ORDER BY worker_instance.expires_at;

SS0016.problem: consumer group still has delivery rows

queries.label: what the delivery rows would discard, by status

SS0017.fix: register the system with Client.System().Register first

SS0018.problem: could not create the covering partition

queries.label: whether the outcomes landed -- rows updated at the commit
the range lease whose expiry settles it either way
queries.sql:
SELECT
	token,
	low,
	high,
	expires_at,
	reclaims
FROM {schema}.claim_lease_{stream_id}
WHERE consumer_group_id = {group_id};

SS0020.fix: stop the stream's producers and call Client.Stream(name).Destroy again

queries.label: the partitions still attached to the log
queries.sql:
SELECT partition.relname AS partition
FROM pg_inherits
JOIN pg_class AS partition ON partition.oid = pg_inherits.inhrelid
WHERE pg_inherits.inhparent = to_regclass('{schema}.message_log_{stream_id}')
ORDER BY partition.relname;

queries.label: whether a producer is still writing -- run it twice
queries.sql: SELECT max(id) AS head, count(*) AS message_count FROM {schema}.message_log_{stream_id};

SS0021.problem: could not finish the stream declaration
SS0021.fix: run Client.Stream(name).Register again if the stream should still exist

queries.label: the steps this database recorded, newest first
queries.sql:
SELECT
	id,
	version,
	min_compatible_version,
	status,
	created_at
FROM {schema}.migration_log
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 20;

SS0023.problem: schema version is newer than this build understands

queries.label: the steps this database recorded, newest first

	status,
	created_at
FROM {schema}.migration_log
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 20;

queries.label: which step raised the floor past this build
queries.sql:
SELECT
	version,
	min_compatible_version,
	created_at
FROM {schema}.migration_log
WHERE min_compatible_version > {build_version}
ORDER BY version;

SS0025.fix: rerun the declaration if the schedule should still exist

SS0034.message: worker instance lost -- stopping, a replacement may already be running

queries.label: the instances holding this worker's rows now
queries.sql:
SELECT
	worker_instance.id,
	worker_instance.token,
	worker_instance.expires_at,
	worker_instance.attempts
FROM {schema}.worker_instance
JOIN {schema}.worker_config ON worker_config.id = worker_instance.worker_id
WHERE worker_config.name = '{worker}'

	stream_id,
	consumer_group_id
FROM {schema}.worker_config
WHERE target_instances = 0
ORDER BY name;

	worker_instance.expires_at,
	worker_instance.attempts
FROM {schema}.worker_config
LEFT JOIN {schema}.worker_instance ON worker_instance.worker_id = worker_config.id
WHERE worker_config.name = '{worker}'
ORDER BY worker_instance.attempts DESC;
